tells: 1. Man in the grey cap slumped face-down onto the table, head buried in his arm against the candle: reads as passed out or clipping into the tabletop, not laughing (club-3-mid.png, centre-left table)

2. Face close is waxy game-CG: plastic uniform skin, a painted cap of hair that reads as bald at the hairline, flat teeth, blurred background figures still showing hard low-poly silhouettes and pale cut-out edges (club-4-face.png, whole frame; blonde at left edge)

3. Front tables in the wide are a posed line-up: everyone square to camera, forearms on tables in near-identical rest poses, legs and chair legs merging into a single dark mass under the tables (club-1-wide.png, front row centre)

4. Laugh onset is small and late: across 1 s only the white-shirt woman and the blonde at the right table visibly open up, the rest stay in listening pose; no build through the room behind (club-5-strip.png, frames t=12.6 to 13.0)

5. Hard black rectangle occluding the bottom of the wide and a flat back-wall bar sign with a rim-lit silhouette that looks like a pasted card (club-1-wide.png / club-6-held.png, lower centre and back right)

1. Floating pale textured card (a paper/hair-card fragment) hanging in mid-air between the blonde laughing woman and the bearded man behind her (theatre-6-held.png, centre, around x 740-790 y 190-300)

2. Front row sits rigidly upright facing camera with hands on knees in matching poses, like a lineup; the second row stands taller than the seat backs so people look like they hover above the seats (theatre-1-wide.png, centre rows)

3. Mid and back rows are flat, unlit cut-outs: identical grey-brown faces with no shading variation and hard opaque silhouettes against the haze, reading as cardboard rather than people in a dark house (theatre-2-mid.png / theatre-3-mid.png, upper half)

4. Laugh lands in sync: at t=12.8 several front-row mouths open at once, and the far-right man drops his head forward at the same moment, so the ripple reads as a trigger rather than a spreading laugh (theatre-5-strip.png, bottom row)

5. Close-up hand and jacket are low-poly with a mushy smeared leather texture and a waxy, over-bright face with a black hole of a mouth; background figures show jagged edge aliasing (theatre-4-face.png, centre and left/right background)

1. Hair card on the face close renders as a hatched, dithered alpha pattern with a see-through fringe at the back of the head, plus a dark rectangular earring/strand artefact below the ear (openmic-4-face.png, right side of the head)

2. Wide reads as a cramped block: forty people packed into a tight wedge, front row knees touching, a huge black void above, a blank glowing door card on the left wall and an empty black floor around them (openmic-1-wide.png, whole frame)
3. Cap/afro texture seam: a visible cross-shaped seam and a hard-edged cap shell sitting on top of the hair (openmic-2-mid.png / openmic-6-held.png, second man from left, head)

4. Front row is evenly lit as if by a fill light with no falloff, so faces look flat and gamey; the back wall is a flat brown plane with no texture and evenly spaced pinpoint lights (openmic-3-mid.png, background and front row)

5. Laugh relies on the same two women turning to each other; the men beside them barely change and the yellow-shirt man holds the same half-smile through all six frames (openmic-5-strip.png, centre figures)
